prompt:
Create a Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2, crisp voxel style using vanilla Minecraft blocks only, plain light background, no characters or animals. Two views side by side: LEFT straight-on north front elevation, orthographic; RIGHT three-quarter view from northeast showing front, east side, rear workshop and garden, at the same block scale. Skilled human builder quality: real massing, depth, projections and recessed framed openings, verges, eaves, ridge, and sub-block stairs, slabs, fences, walls, trapdoors and lanterns. Keep both views consistent. Small view labels and discreet exact-id material callouts are welcome; avoid a large legend crowding the build.

Site: A candle maker's home and shop in an English market town, its eaves to a cobbled street to the north. Site 26 blocks wide x 34 deep. Main house 13 wide x 11 deep, two storeys plus a 45-degree grey slate roof, ridge at 16 blocks and chimney to 19. Grey stone-brick plinth. Ground storey warm red brick with long-and-short stone quoins. Centered five-wide shop bay projects one block: dark-oak posts, three glass panes glowing with clusters of yellow and white candles, dark-oak fascia with shop sign. Dark-oak shop door with glazed transom to its left; separate family door with little stone hood to its right. Upper storey projects one block on upside-down dark-oak stair brackets, half-timbered near-black dark-oak posts and beams with off-white calcite daub, pair of windows above bay, diagonal braces in outer panels made from stepped vanilla timber components. Real 45-degree grey slate roof with dark-oak verges, slab ridge, two small street-facing gabled dormers. Red-brick chimney with dark band and smoking cap on east gable. West corner dark-oak bracket carries hanging sign with lit three-candle cluster at its tip.
Behind house: lower single-storey brick workshop 9 x 10 under own slate gable; second tall brick chimney at back gable with tall plume of campfire smoke from tallow-rendering hearth. Against workshop east side: open dark-oak lean-to sheltering candle drying racks and tallow barrels. Spruce picket fence encloses rear garden, row of exactly four beehives, bright flower bed, woodpile beside chimney, barrels and cauldron beside side gate, apple tree represented by oak_log and oak_leaves, dirt_path from side gate. Show yard clearly in right view without moving it in front of house. Smoke is vanilla campfire particles.

Use this palette by exact Minecraft block ids:

plinth: stone_bricks, mossy_stone_bricks, stone_brick_stairs, stone_brick_slab, stone_brick_wall.

roof: cobbled_deepslate, deepslate_tiles, polished_deepslate, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, cobbled_deepslate_slab, deepslate_tile_stairs, deepslate_tile_slab, polished_deepslate_stairs, polished_deepslate_slab, tuff_brick_stairs, tuff_brick_slab.

Available functional and decorative objects: spruce_planks, oak_planks, white_carpet, white_bed, red_bed, bookshelf, lectern, grindstone, smoker, furnace, flower_pot, potted_poppy, potted_dandelion, decorated_pot, chest, crafting_table. Use these only where visible and appropriate; do not expose interiors by cutaway. No custom blocks, smooth diagonal beams, non-voxel furniture or realistic candles.
changes: Saved the generated image unchanged as concept.png in the current directory.

This is raster concept art, not a block inventory or schematic. The roles retain every planned block; additional ids are visual interpretations and build equivalents. Similar textures, hidden blocks, flower species and empty versus filled cauldrons cannot all be identified exactly.
The right view places the fenced garden beside the house and workshop, extending toward the street, rather than exclusively behind the house.

The stated footprint, house and workshop dimensions, projection depths, 45-degree roof pitch, ridge height and chimney height are not verifiable from the rendered block courses. Dimension captions assert site dimensions without proving them.
Three chimney-like stacks appear in the right view: the house brick chimney, workshop brick chimney and an additional narrow dark stack behind the workshop. Only two were planned.
The workshop chimney smoke plume is not clearly taller than the house chimney plume.
Upper-storey diagonal bracing appears doubled in the outer panels; some timber pieces and joints have finer geometry than vanilla stairs and slabs.
The upper-storey jetty and shop bay projection are suggested but their exact one-block depths are unclear.
Added flower boxes beneath both upper windows, barrel planters and small pots at street level, and many extra lanterns on doors, dormers, workshop and lean-to.

The fascia sign and west hanging sign show candle pictograms instead of lettering. They resemble framed display panels; the west sign encloses its three candles rather than placing a separate lit cluster on the bracket tip.
Doors include custom-looking glazing, hinges and brass hardware that do not match vanilla dark_oak_door or spruce_door textures exactly.
Roof and chimney caps show dark brick-like masonry interpreted as deepslate_bricks, deepslate_brick_stairs and deepslate_brick_slab beyond the listed roof palette.
Added mossy cobblestone paving, slab-like pavement edging and short grass, interpreted with the corresponding ids in the role lists.
Four beehives are visible, but they stand on custom-looking narrow supports rather than showing an unambiguous vanilla placement.
The apple tree has conspicuous red apples attached to its foliage. Vanilla oak_leaves do not display attached apple fruit, and there is no vanilla apple block.
Drying candles hang as elongated taper shapes under the lean-to; vanilla candle blocks cannot reproduce those suspended forms exactly.
The rear woodpile resembles densely packed small log rounds rather than exclusively full-block spruce_log pieces.
The front elevation labels its cropped frontage as the full 26-block site width, although the entire garden footprint is not shown in that view.

Exact block-id material callouts were omitted. Some planned materials and interior objects are not visibly represented; beds, bookshelf, lectern, grindstone, smoker, furnace, chest and crafting_table are not identifiable.
